# Vendor Documentation

This folder contains vendor-supplied CREST documentation and templates.

## Files

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [CREST-WebGUI+Migration-Guide.pdf](CREST-WebGUI+Migration-Guide.pdf) | Guide for migrating to the CREST Web GUI. |
| [CREST-WebGUI+Operational-Setup-Guide.pdf](CREST-WebGUI+Operational-Setup-Guide.pdf) | Operational setup instructions for CREST Web GUI environments. |
| [PAT Checklist Template Wave 3.docx](PAT%20Checklist%20Template%20Wave%203.docx) | Participant Acceptance Testing checklist template for Wave 3. |
| [.gitkeep](.gitkeep) | Placeholder file so the folder remains tracked when content changes. |

## Usage

- Treat these files as source reference material.
- Add new vendor documents with clear, versioned filenames when possible.
